faults.title: Nested branch regions with a skipped branch and a required failing branch: join fires exactly once or the run fails explicitly, never waits forever
faults.injection_point: a real debug Run of a nested condition/join graph (choose -> choose2 -> {deep|shallow} -> join2 -> join <- direct) whose branch nodes are real call_app delegations; sub-case A executes the selected child normally, sub-case B gives the parent a 0.00000001 USD allowance so the required child's real model reservation is refused (budget_exhausted)
expected: sub-case A: each join fires exactly once; the envelope names one activated and one skipped source; the run succeeds
sub-case B: the required child's real failure fails the run with its stable code; neither join fires and no node waits forever
the durable run event sequence stays contiguous and every skip is published once
